verdict.summary: ATLANTAELE (51/100) — Reject / AVOID. Trend Template and investability gates pass, but the stock fails on its own merits: no valid VCP or constructive base (base_structure 4/20, pattern_label empty, 30.6% deep and price 12.33% below pivot), zero leadership points, and a broken earnings record — latest-quarter EPS YoY is negative (-82.6%), 3-yr EPS CAGR is -13.9%, and annual EPS growth is only 7.8%. RS percentile 93 is the lone bright spot, but with the 50 DMA not rising and price stuck mid-base, there is nothing actionable. Score is well below the 60 Watchlist-B floor; unverified fields (base_count, industry group RS, marquee institution, MF scheme count, new catalyst, governance events, group leadership rank) were correctly scored 0.
strengths: Revenue engine intact: latest-quarter sales +47.9% YoY, 3-yr sales CAGR 32.1%, B1 maxed at 6/6
Profitability quality: ROE 31.7%, ROCE 45.3%, 3-yr OCF/PAT 0.92, net margin +24 bps YoY
Clean balance sheet: D/E 0.05, interest coverage 6.8x, zero promoter pledge
Investability gate passes: median daily traded value ~₹18.1 cr
weaknesses: Latest-quarter EPS YoY -82.6% — a sharp deceleration that undercuts the entire earnings thesis
3-yr EPS CAGR -13.9% and latest annual EPS growth only 7.8% (A3/A4 = 0)
Base structure fails: 30.6% depth, no labeled pattern, no volume dry-up (-6.1% vs -30% required), weekly closes not tight (5.28%)
Zero sponsorship improvement — E1/E2/E3 all 0, and share count grew 7.14% over 2 yrs (D3 = 0)
50 DMA not rising; price 12.33% below pivot and 20.3% off the 52-week high
Sector/industry group classification unverified — H1/H2 cannot be assessed
verdict.biggest_risk: Earnings infidelity: a single quarter of -82.6% EPS YoY after 40–113% growth in the prior three quarters suggests either a high-base effect or genuine margin/order-book deterioration. Without a verified explanation (management commentary, order book disclosure, capacity schedule), the pattern is indistinguishable from a broken growth story.
